verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents an Account Balance service under its Pay product line that returns real-time or cached balances from the customer's financial institution. Pay-oriented capabilities sit alongside it, such as 'Predict payment success', which fits a pre-payment balance check. missing for 10: explicit documentation framing the balance endpoint for NSF/risk checks, endpoint-level detail (request/response, refresh behavior for real-time vs cached), independent or hands-on corroboration.
